description: This file contains Python code implementing functions and classes related to overload set analysis, including effective overload set computation, for use in WebIDL overload resolution algorithms.

classes.name: OverloadSetAdapter
classes.description: Base class defining the interface for overload set adapters, providing methods to retrieve arguments, types, optionality, and variadic status of function parameters.

classes.name: MethodContextAdapter
classes.description: Subclass of OverloadSetAdapter that implements the interface for method objects represented as dictionaries with specific keys.

methods.name: sort_and_groupby
methods.description: Sorts a list and groups items by a key function, returning a generator of (key, list) tuples.

methods.name: effective_overload_set
methods.description: Computes the effective overload set for a list of overloads, considering argument types and optionality, following WebIDL specifications.

methods.name: effective_overload_set_by_length
methods.description: Groups overloads by the length of their argument type lists after computing the effective overload set.

methods.name: method_overloads_by_name
methods.description: Returns overloaded methods grouped by their name from a list of method dictionaries.
